text:
anita: FYI seeing a class of failed embed requests where preflight said ok but runtime 413s on redwood-embed-large. console shows routing_hint=tier_affinity.
rob: can you paste a sanitized example? rough size?
anita: big batch ~600KB JSON payload, 512-dim vectors, header X-Embed-Meta: tier=enterprise. preflight_estimate ~480KB but runtime_bytes ~620KB.
dan: our estimator uses dims*4 heuristic; JSON encoding and per-vector overhead explains delta. we should surface estimator_version in telemetry.
claire: agree. suggest attaching preflight_estimate_bytes and estimator_version to request metadata so console + runtime can correlate. also add a mismatch counter.
lisa: product note: we shouldn't auto-split by default. customers might rely on atomicity. prefer opt-in header X-Embed-Client-Behavior: allow_split.
rob: for immediate triage: add telemetry metric embed_size_mismatch{env,model} and a dashboard tile percent_mismatch. alert if >0.2% and >500/day.
dan: also propose adding fields in 413 error: {"code": "embed_oversize_estimate_diff", "estimate_bytes": ..., "runtime_bytes": ..., "request_id": ...} so SDKs can show actionable guidance.
claire: SDKs: add helper to chunk by recommended max_payload_bytes and update changelog. lisa to coordinate customer comms.
rob: small infra ask: we have multiple header variants (X-Embed-Meta, X-Client-Meta). normalize at ingress to X-Client-Meta to reduce SDK fragmentation.
anita: also want sampled traces showing preflight_estimate vs runtime_size (1% sampling) with hashed client_id only.
dan: will emit preflight_hash to join traces across ingress->runtime->console. retention 14 days for canary debug.
lisa: privacy check: hashed client_id ok, please truncate in UI to 8 chars. add playbook note to purge hashes after 7 days.
infra-bot: deploy 1715012380 by rob: preflight annotate + telemetry counter -> staging
rob: PR https://git.redwood.internal/p/r/12421 adds estimator v0.3 tag, preflight_estimate metadata, mismatch telemetry, and 413 error schema change.
dan: will wire preflight_hash + trace sampling. adding a small counter mismatch_delta_bytes histogram.
claire: console UX: add columns estimated_size / actual_size with tooltip explaining differences. hide raw values unless internal feature flag.
rob: adding feature-flag embed_preflight_v0_3 and canary to 20% traffic for 2 hours, sampling bumped to 5% during canary.
anita: running canary now, will report anomalies.
lisa: will prepare SDK guidance and opt-in splitting docs in case we follow that path later.
rob: followups assigned: rob (deploy + dashboard), dan (traces + telemetry), claire (SDK liaison), lisa (customer comms).
anita: thanks team, keeping eye on embed_oversize_estimate_diff spikes.
